# Yoga Gallery Images

Place the 5 yoga pose images in this folder with the following names:

1. `pose1.jpg` - Warrior III Pose (first image)
2. `pose2.jpg` - Warrior III Pose (second angle)
3. `pose3.jpg` - Crescent Lunge (first image)
4. `pose4.jpg` - Crescent Lunge (second angle)
5. `pose5.jpg` - Tree Pose

## How to add your images:

1. Copy the 5 yoga photos you attached in the chat
2. Rename them as listed above (pose1.jpg, pose2.jpg, etc.)
3. Place them in this folder: `public/yoga-gallery/`
4. Restart the dev server if needed

The gallery will automatically display on the About page.
